This compound is identified as a target of two different molecules, 5-Hydroxymethyl-9-methoxycanthin-6-one and Cochinchinenone, both of which are linked to the Dr hemagglutinin structural subunit. The integration of these pathways implies that the compound may act as a modulator or inhibitor of the target protein, possibly through a common mechanism involving mitochondrial function or metabolic pathways. The evidence supports a potential role for this compound in regulating the structural subunit of hemagglutinin, though the exact mechanism of interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
